description: Source code for the core plugin of a lighttpd-based server, implementing socket listening, configuration parsing, and process management.

classes.name: listen_socket
classes.description: Represents a listening socket with reference counting.

classes.name: listen_ref_resource
classes.description: Resource wrapper for a listen_socket used in instance resources.

classes.name: plugin_parsing
classes.description: Holds parsing state and configuration for plugin setup.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for the core plugin, including runtime state.

classes.name: listen_mask
classes.description: Represents a network or UNIX socket address mask for ACLs.

methods.name: core_parse_check_parameter_string
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string parameter.

methods.name: core_parse_store_string
methods.description: Stores a string parameter into a target GString.

methods.name: core_parse_store_string_list
methods.description: Stores a list of strings into a GPtrArray.

methods.name: core_parse_store_integer
methods.description: Stores an integer value into a target.

methods.name: core_parse_user
methods.description: Parses and sets the user for the process.

methods.name: core_parse_group
methods.description: Parses and sets the group for the process.

methods.name: core_parse_binary
methods.description: Parses the binary path.

methods.name: core_parse_config
methods.description: Parses the configuration file path.

methods.name: core_parse_luaconfig
methods.description: Parses the Lua configuration path.

methods.name: core_parse_modules_path
methods.description: Parses the modules path.

methods.name: add_env
methods.description: Adds an environment variable to the environment array.

methods.name: core_parse_env
methods.description: Parses environment variables.

methods.name: core_parse_copy_env
methods.description: Copies environment variables from the current environment.

methods.name: core_parse_wrapper
methods.description: Parses wrapper commands.

methods.name: core_parse_max_core_file_size
methods.description: Parses max core dump file size.

methods.name: core_parse_max_open_files
methods.description: Parses max open files limit.

methods.name: core_listen_mask_free
methods.description: Frees a listen_mask structure.

methods.name: core_parse_allow_listen
methods.description: Parses allowed listen socket addresses.

methods.description: Validates and prepares the plugin configuration for startup.

methods.description: Creates a new listen_socket with reference count 0.

methods.name: listen_socket_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count of a listen_socket.

methods.description: Releases a listen_socket resource, closing socket if refcount reaches zero.

methods.name: listen_socket_add
methods.description: Adds a listen_socket resource to an instance.

methods.name: listen_check_acl
methods.description: Checks if a socket address matches ACL masks.

methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a socket based on address family.

methods.name: core_listen
methods.description: Handles a request to listen on a socket address, creating socket if needed.

methods.name: core_reached_state
methods.description: Handles state change notifications.

methods.name: core_log_open_file
methods.description: Handles log file opening requests.

methods.name: core_free
methods.description: Frees and cleans up plugin configuration.

methods.name: core_stop
methods.description: Stops the plugin, releasing resources.

methods.name: core_activate
methods.description: Activates a new configuration, replacing old instances.

methods.name: core_instance_replaced
methods.description: Handles replacement of an instance.

methods.description: Handles SIGHUP signal for graceful restart.

methods.description: Initializes plugin data and hooks.

methods.description: Entry point to initialize the core plugin.
